Senior Product Manager, Growth
Company: Northwind Labs

About the role:
We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to own our activation and retention funnels.

Requirements:
- 4+ years of product management experience
- Proven experience running experimentation programs to improve activation
- Strong SQL and product analytics skills
- Experience managing a team of 10+ direct reports
- Experience with B2B SaaS products

Nice to have:
- Experience with fraud/risk systems
- Familiarity with Figma
